features.name: Checkout Page
features.purpose: Lets a customer review the basket, pay, and place the order.

features.name: Orders API
features.purpose: Creates orders and keeps their payment status in step with the payment provider.

features.name: Account Dashboard
features.purpose: Shows a customer their balances, recent orders, and saved payment methods.

functionalities.name: Checkout Page - Publish payment requested event

acceptance_criteria.description: When the customer confirms payment, a payment-requested event is published with the order id and amount
When publishing fails, the order is not placed and the error PAYMENT_UNAVAILABLE is shown

notes: Integration tests stub payment-events with an in-memory fake publisher.

acceptance_criteria.description: The order total equals the sum of line totals plus delivery

functionalities.name: Orders API - Reconcile payment status

acceptance_criteria.description: When a payment-settled event arrives, the order moves to PAID
When a payment-failed event arrives, the order moves to PAYMENT_FAILED

notes: Tests feed hand-built payment-events messages; no contract backs their shape.

acceptance_criteria.description: The dashboard lists the five most recent orders, newest first
